claims.text: The FDA dalteparin boxed warning lists concurrent platelet inhibitors, including aspirin's class, as risk factors for spinal or epidural hematoma during neuraxial procedures.
claims.quote: Factors that can increase the risk of developing epidural or spinal hematomas in these patients include: • Use of indwelling epidural catheters • Concomitant use of other drugs that affect hemostasis, such as non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), platelet inhibitors

headline.text: The FDA dalteparin warning identifies platelet inhibitors, including aspirin's class, as spinal or epidural hematoma risk factors during neuraxial procedures.

reported.text: This warning concerns spinal or epidural hematomas in anticoagulated patients undergoing neuraxial anesthesia or spinal puncture.

gaps.text: The packet contains no human study isolating bleeding risk from concurrent aspirin and dalteparin.
